messages:
Noah: Opening thread for VelaFinance POC. They returned our enterprise auth checklist and asked for precise answers on SAML attribute mapping, SCIM incremental behaviour, SCIM burst throttles, RBAC provisioning flow, domain ownership proof options, and whether Hosted vs Dedicated impacts login fallback and key management. They also want a short POC pricing direction. @Priya @Diego can you take the details?

Priya: SCIM defaults: delta_window = 900s (15m). For Dedicated we can configure delta_window down to 300s; for time-limited POCs we can temporarily allow 60s but we will monitor and may throttle if CPU spikes. Default rate_limit = 300 req/min/tenant; temporary POC bump to 800 req/min for up to 10 days is possible with advance notice. Recommend staging an initial seed via the batch endpoint to avoid hitting rate limits.

Diego: SAML/RBAC mapping: primary pattern is SAML assertion attribute named `roles` (comma-separated) mapped to internal roles via an explicit mapping table in the Console. SCIM groups can also be mapped to roles. We do not auto-promote to org_admin; admin elevation requires an explicit mapping entry. Delegated-admin mode is opt-in and emits extra audit events. Sample mapping we give customers: `idp:ProdAdmin -> platform_admin`, `idp:Viewer -> viewer`.

Noah: Security wants a one-line for IdP outage: can users still access?

Priya: One-line for questionnaire: "Optional email magic-link fallback is supported when enabled; on Dedicated deployments fallback depends on customer network/egress and KMS policies and requires explicit enablement. All fallback sign-ins are logged."

Diego: Domain verification: supported methods are DNS TXT (recommended for email subdomains), HTTP token verification, and signed SAML metadata. For quick onboarding choose DNS TXT.

Noah: Hosted vs Dedicated short note for Sales: functionally equivalent for SAML/OIDC + SCIM. Dedicated adds private KMS, VPC egress controls, configurable SCIM rate-limits, and the ability to tune delta windows lower. Pricing: Hosted POC uses usage pricing + trial credits; Dedicated requires a short-term reserved commit priced by throughput and capacity. Sales should capture expected total users, peak daily deltas, and group count to size the commit.

Lena: Ops: please schedule a staging tenant for the POC after sizing. Also confirm whether we can temporarily raise the SCIM rate to 800/min for the requested window.

infra-bot: Staging tenant deploy pending. Please submit sizing sheet to infra queue to approve temporary SCIM throttle raise.

Noah: Numbers from customer: initial user base ~22k, expected daily delta ~4k, groups ~150. I'll attach the spreadsheet.

Priya: For these numbers we recommend: set rate_limit_per_min = 800 for POC, enable SCIM batch endpoint, and use a 300s delta on Dedicated or 900s on Hosted. We'll provide the SCIM config snippet and monitoring dashboard links.

Diego: SCIM QA sample (for docs): PATCH /scim/v2/Users body: [ { "op": "replace", "path": "emails[0].value", "value": "u@velafinance.com" } ] and include exponential backoff on 429.

Noah: Action items: @Priya upload SCIM config + monitoring links; @Diego draft RBAC mapping doc and security one-liner; Sales to confirm commit band if customer wants Dedicated POC. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
